summary: FS page (updated 2026-11-09), recreation.gov search and imagery read. Free, 5 sites, vault toilet confirmed; no recreation.gov listing -> first-come; season May-Oct (closed for winter now, not a closure order); FS alert 'no potable water' -> potable_water false. Riverfront -> creekside: the Susan River is ~4-6 m wide here; the west-bank spurs are ~15-25 m from it over open pine ground. Phone '' -> 530-257-4188.
flags: WATERFRONT 'riverfront' -> 'creekside' (size rule, not a distance downgrade). Imagery (z19 at 40.41285,-120.86215): the Susan River at the camp is a ~4-6 m meandering stream, far under the ~30 m riverfront threshold. Spurs on the west bank with parked rigs at ~40.41272,-120.86232 (~15 m from the channel) and ~40.41296,-120.86227 (~20-25 m), over flat, open, needle-floored ground with scattered pines and no continuous screen - passes the creekside easy-walk test. FS: 'There are 5 campsites located along Susan River'. FS publishes no site numbers or map, so I can't say which site is which; all five line the bank. Replacement evidence: 'FS Lassen page: 5 campsites along the Susan River; Esri z19 2026-11-27: stream ~4-6 m wide; west-bank spurs ~15-25 m from the channel over flat open pine ground at 40.4127-40.4130,-120.8623 -> creekside (too narrow for riverfront)'.
BOOKING: no recreation.gov listing (search 2026-11-27) -> first-come, as stored; platform 'none' added.

FACILITIES: potable_water true -> false on the FS alert 'Currently, no potable water is available at site. Plan to bring all needed water for your stay.' (page updated 2026-11-09). The same page says the water is normally turned on in April or May, so recheck in spring.
ACCESS (quote, not a drop): 'Accessing Goumaz by way of 44 is recommended when towing trailers.' No 4WD or high-clearance wording.
STATUS: 'Closed for 2026/2027 winter season' is the seasonal closure, not a closure order; status left open.
